stories.title: Kamini Kaushal died in Mumbai on 13 November, aged 98
stories.body: Filmfare Best Actress (1956) for Biraj Bahu; her debut Neecha Nagar (1946) remains the only Indian film to win the Cannes Palme d'Or.

one_liners: Kamini Kaushal died in Mumbai on 13 November, aged 98 — Filmfare Best Actress (1956) for Biraj Bahu
